remarks: Welcome to this charming single-family rental in the highly desirable Cranbury neighborhood of Norwalk. Nestled on a beautifully maintained half-acre flat lot, this home features 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, the home boasts a versatile layout ideal for modern living. The bright main level is complemented by a finished lower-level living area - perfect for a family room or 4th bedroom.  Enjoy outdoor living with a double-deck setup overlooking the expansive backyard, ideal for entertaining or relaxing in a private setting. Additional highlights include a 1-car garage and an oversized driveway with parking for up to 8 cars.   Located in one of Norwalk's most sought-after neighborhoods, this home offers easy access to local amenities, parks, schools, and major commuting routes.
